reviews.text: With that said, the characters had grown on me and the story kept me on tip toes. All those elements combined gave me a constant "butterfly feeling" in my tummy.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text: There were so many secrets going on in this book. I couldn't put my kindle down because I needed to know what was really going on.

reviews.name: Quinn's Quippy Quotes
reviews.text: This was my first novel by Ashley Claudy and was pleasantly surprised with the complexity of it. I will definitely be reading more from her.

reviews.name: kambriehaas
reviews.text: I was looking for a good book to read and boy was this it. I finished it in less than 24 hours and literally could not put it down.

reviews.name: caydii

reviews.name: Melluvsbooks
reviews.text: Bottom line? If you like an aggressive college athlete H and an innocent h who makes him work for it, you'll like this.

reviews.name: Aliyeh
reviews.text: Four stars for Drew and Brooklyn. I am conflicted with this one. I did enjoy it and had a hard time putting it down but at the same time Drew really frustrated me.

reviews.name: allcassreads
reviews.text: I love this book! I love Andrew, I love Brook, it was so good. This book was just chef's kiss perfection.

reviews.name: Have Coffee Need Books
reviews.text: This has great pacing; it has so many layers that are building to the climax and then you sink into a whole lot of wtf that will leave you feeling like you missed the clues. Ashley Claudy is word maestro.

reviews.name: Heather in FL
reviews.text: This was another roller coaster ride. I was, again, on the edge of my seat, waiting for what's next.

reviews.name: Carrie
reviews.text: Wow!! I feel like I need to wipe my brow after reading this one. It's definitely as awesome as the first book.

reviews.name: Caryl Casanova
reviews.text: It's like you're also in the ring throwing those friggin punches!

reviews.name: Desiree Mosley - A Love Affair With Books
reviews.text: 'Inside Danger' was full of suspense and intrigue. There are many twists and turns you will never see coming.

reviews.name: Karen Voitik
reviews.text: Rusnak reminds me of a wild animal that may or may not be trained, able to turn on you without warning.

reviews.name: Romance Readers Retreat
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this book. The characters are perfectly carried through from book #1 and I felt Regan's dilemmas whole heartedly. Gage's frustration and strong desperation is portrayed so effectively, that you feel it too.

reviews.name: Barb
reviews.text: I will continue to read this series because I became invested so much in the story that I want to know what is coming next.

reviews.name: 2OCC Reviews
reviews.text: The writing was really good, I was surprised that this was Ashley Claudy's first novel as she has all the elements of a great writer already.

reviews.name: Natalie
reviews.text: It was funny, sad, and infuriating at times. It was an amazing story about how the darkness in our past shouldn't limit the brightness of our future.

reviews.name: Laura Lambregts
reviews.text: 'It Goes On' is easy to read, has great conversation and is unpredictable. The characters are diverse and not cliché at all, unlike so many other books of the genre. The pace of the story is perfect and I keep turning the pages knowing there's not a boring sentence in the book.

reviews.name: Mari Denae
reviews.text: This one grew on me... slowly. As Kate evolved, so did my appreciation for this story. I'm glad I didn't give up because it was worth it.

reviews.name: Mira
reviews.text: Don't usually review books I get for free/near free on Kindle but I was pleasantly surprised by this one. I appreciated the themes of lifetime hurt from an untrustworthy parent; feeling stunted by emotions/survival mechanism; being drawn into, but not lost, a fast-paced crowd.

reviews.name: Jennifer Anderson
reviews.text: Great book couldn't put it down. It was like 90210 n gossip girl all in one. I love that Kate stayed true to herself

reviews.name: Brianna
reviews.text: Started off a little slow I almost put the book down but once I got to page 70ish I couldn't put it down. It really grew on me and wish there was more.

reviews.name: Blakley Farrow
reviews.text: Kate really grew on me. Her personal development was not forced but a bit more realistic.

reviews.name: The Insomniac Book Hoarder
reviews.text: The pacing was amazing!!" … "Overall a fantastic read!

reviews.name: sarajane_turner
reviews.text: I really enjoyed reading this book from the beginning. I really like Kate and her outlook.

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text: I thought about rating this lower but after I got to the end, a lower star rating just wouldn't do, so...a solid five stars.

reviews.name: Gail
reviews.text: OMG OMG OMG… JUST WOW!!! I cannot explain just how much I loved this book..

reviews.name: Jessika
reviews.text: Probably one of my favorite series of all time. This series should be made into films. It's brilliant, thrilling, beautiful, and terrifying all at the same time.

reviews.name: Lyssa Reyome
reviews.text: Gage and Regan always keep you on the edge of your seat, wondering what will happen next in the crazy story they call life.

reviews.name: Angela
reviews.text: Wow what a roller coaster ride. This is a terrific ending to an awesome series. Gage and Reagan are some of the best characters I've come across.

reviews.name: Romance Readers Retreat
reviews.text: This book is well written and certainly keeps you guessing all the way through. I really enjoyed it and hope you do too.

reviews.name: Amanda Neilly
reviews.text: Wow, this book is best of series! It's heart wrenching heartbreaking and you will literally be unable to put it down!

reviews.name: Misty
reviews.text: This series was something else! Emotional, dark, haunting...it definitely wasn't your typical romance.

reviews.name: Christine Kaplan
reviews.text: Great book. Loved the characters and the storyline.

reviews.name: Vivian
reviews.text: So with those reminders, I do give this 4 stars. This being the last book, the conclusion did feel right.

reviews.name: Yelena Bosh
reviews.text: Heartbreaking. Sexy. Hot. Unforgiving. Intense. Sad. Raw. Beautiful. Powerful. Just simply too good to pass up.

reviews.name: Desiree Mosley - A Love Affair With Books
reviews.text: In all honesty, I never put my iPad back down once I started reading it.

reviews.name: ~♡AB♡~
reviews.text: A great debut from Ashley Claudy, I had trouble putting this one down and will definitely recommend this to those who love a fast paced romantic suspense.

reviews.name: Loz
reviews.text: I started this one expecting yet another 'fighter' book but what we get is actually a fresh new take.

reviews.name: Ashleyjo
reviews.text: This was not at all what I expected. I expected a sexy romance of a manwhore fighter and a downtrodden orphan female fighter. Although those shoes may fit, that barely scraped the surface of what all this book entails.

reviews.name: t'irla ~The Bookslayer~ aka Barbara
reviews.text: Outside the Ropes was a fresh take on the fighter story and Ashley Claudy has a real talent for writing interesting characters with hidden depth and dark edges.

reviews.name: Shannon
reviews.text: Wow, this book really took me by surprised! If you're looking for a raw, gritty, story with a strong, take-no-prisoners heroine, this is the book for you.

reviews.name: Katie
reviews.text: Highly recommend this book who would love to read a good action packed, sports themed, romance novel!

reviews.name: Stacey
reviews.text: Ride is a heartfelt, emotionally layered story about love, vulnerability, and the courage it takes to let someone truly see you. Ashley Claudy writes with a raw honesty that pulls you in quickly and doesn't let go.

reviews.name: Katie
reviews.text: I love Evie and West, and the angst and tension between them was unreal, making everything that much hotter. I couldn't put it down. I was reading on my lunch break, brushing my teeth, doing my makeup, when I was supposed to be sleeping, any downtime I had.

reviews.name: ScarletFix
reviews.text: I love the characters, especially Evie she was so strong yet vulnerable she was my absolute favorite and her chemistry with West was insane. It is a little slower paced but in a way that keeps you more engaged and fully invested, more than well worth a read!

reviews.name: A Bull In A Bookshop
reviews.text: I liked this. It was a good time of a read. Now while the insta-love adjacent romance almost made me deduct a star, the action was intense and exciting. So that final star stays.

reviews.name: Heidi
reviews.text: Apart they were just two Hot Messes, but together they balanced each other. I went through several emotions reading this.

reviews.name: BeaC
reviews.text: The chemistry between Evie and West is absolutely electric. The pacing is spot on, blending the romance with a sense of urgency that had my heart racing.

reviews.name: Johanna
reviews.text: The characters were very complex and compelling and complicated and perfectly steamy together. Plot was intriguing and intense and exciting and well paced. Thoroughly enjoyed and highly recommend.

reviews.name: Kimberly
reviews.text: This book had me hooked from start to finish. I could not put it down and I finished it in one day.

reviews.name: Chloe Devlin
reviews.text: Evie and West are so cute and their story is super fairytale like. The races are fun to read and the story keeps your attention.

reviews.name: Tesherrion
reviews.text: The gritty tone, the sense of danger, and the tension woven through the characters create a compelling backdrop that fits the genre really well. The atmosphere, the character dynamics, and the overall concept remain compelling.

reviews.name: chrissycf
reviews.text: I went from hating Drew, to falling in love with him at the end.

reviews.name: Allie
reviews.text: It’s refreshing to read about a female lead who is not an idiot, who stands her ground, and does not let her past control her life.

reviews.name: Cameron
reviews.text: I fell in love with Brook, she was a klutz, awkward, funny and of course extremely nice. I always loved Drew as soon as he was introduced.

reviews.name: Brittany
reviews.text: I read it twice in the same week because I loved it. It was sexy and entertaining, and it had plot twists that blew me away.

reviews.name: Hisnhersnyours
reviews.text: My lungs just about burst from holding my breath for so long during those last chapters. Intense!

reviews.name: Azia
reviews.text: If you want a book that has you kicking your feet at the tension- then this is the one for you!

reviews.name: Jimery Dessus
reviews.text: The character development was great. Very well written.

reviews.name: Amazon Customer
reviews.text: This book hit every single thing I absolutely love and need in a book. It had the hot males, strong female, angst, love, sexiness, suspense and I'll even take some drama.

reviews.name: Brittany Price
reviews.text: He was head over heels for Brooklyn, and I absolutely loved how much he adored her, even through all of the crap being thrown at her!

reviews.name: Kristin
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this story. Definitely found a new author to follow and I am so glad I one clicked this book.

reviews.name: Angie
reviews.text: I have read a few sports/romance books in my time and this one is probably the best I've ever read.

reviews.name: M. Hayes
reviews.text: Action packed gritty drama that really pulls at the heartstrings.

reviews.name: rjrnj1
reviews.text: Her writing is tight, her pacing flows, her characters are rich and three-dimensional, and the dialogue feels authentic.

reviews.name: Amazon Customer
reviews.text: Very interesting, very sexy, action packed love story that got me laughing, gave me goose bumps, kept me on the edge of my seat and made me feel the feelings that the characters felt!!!

reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.text: Awesome book! Real and captivating. I love how strong Regan is.

reviews.name: 10914 Reviews

reviews.name: Tess
reviews.text: I couldn't put it down, loved the character development and did not see the biggest twist coming!

reviews.name: Stephanie
reviews.text: LISTEN: this book is one of the best I have EVER read.

reviews.name: Kindle Customer
reviews.text: Ashley Claudy is a great writer, knows how to keep an audience excited and wanting more. Can't wait to see where this story goes in the next book.

reviews.name: Chelseam93
reviews.text: I fell in love with Rae and gage from the beginning even though there were so many issues that were in the way of their true feelings.

reviews.name: Lydia
reviews.text: Another great book from Ashley. I love love love her books.

reviews.name: Angie
reviews.text: Gage and Reagan are some of the best characters I've come across.

reviews.name: Val
reviews.text: I applaud how different this made Gage, how real it made him, he’s someone who is flawed, who has moments of weakness and makes mistakes, instead of the perfect cookie cutter alpha male, so often seen in books today.

reviews.name: L&S
reviews.text: This was a crazy dark and totally intense romance novel that keeps you on edge.

reviews.name: Butterfly
reviews.text: I was not ready for all of the twist and turns. Loved the first book, love this one.

reviews.name: Angie
reviews.text: if you love 'will they won't they' tropes you are going to love this.

reviews.name: Book please
reviews.text: First it made me fall in love with Liam then it made me fall in love with Ethan, and it kept ping ponging between the two.

reviews.name: Bailey
reviews.text: I seriously love this book and check the author's page to see if she is coming out with another book that follows any of the other characters.

reviews.name: Lydia
reviews.text: Love love loved it and could not put it down. Seriously read this book and get addicted to Ashleys fantastic writing.
